scripts.test:dev:open: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --ui"
scripts.test:run: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently --kill-others --success first "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test && echo 'Tests passed - server will be closed'"
scripts.test:run:build: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently --kill-others --success first "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test"
scripts.test:sequential: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently --kill-others --success first "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --workers=1 --fully-parallel=false"
scripts.test:ci: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently --kill-others --success first --raw "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --reporter=list"
scripts.test:debug: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --debug"
scripts.test:headed: env-cmd -f .env.test concurrently "npm run build && npm run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --headed"
